scope: Original Nemesis basic-board standard semi-cooperative six original characters; original English manual and scoped officialFAQ, supplemental original PL/FR/DE manuals. No summary or sources other than listed; no key/questions/reader/grade/prior audit.

independence.inputs_read: Only the input manifest, its fixed summary snapshot and listed authoritative source files. No question banks, keys, reader answers, grades, prior audits, source-gap/discovery records or web were consulted; no reader communication occurred.

source_coverage.manuals: English, Polish, French and German original manuals: all standard-game material on printed pp.1–26 and p.28 read; p.27 alternate modes/board excluded from ruling scope. English p.23 was rendered for visual verification of crafting component symbols.
source_coverage.faq: Official FAQ v2.2, dated 16 April 2025: base-game Rules 1–26, Actions 1–19, Rooms 1–9 and Items 1–10 checked, with cooperative and Intruder-player clauses excluded. Expansion sections do not supply rulings.

summary_location.section: Player Reference / Additional Rooms / Room Covered With Slime

findings.finding: The Room reference says entry automatically gives Slime, but does not state that this happens before resolving the Exploration token. The generic entry procedure resolves exploration first without this exception. On first revealing this Room with a Silence token, that omission can produce Silence rather than the required Danger.

source_references.section: Slime and Room Covered With Slime

findings.supported_repair: Add to the Room Covered With Slime entry: Place the Slime marker before resolving its Exploration token; a Silence token therefore resolves as Danger.
findings.reason_for_using_localization: PL and FR explicitly give this timing. It is consistent with the English automatic-on-entry effect and Slime conversion, rather than replacing a conflicting English timing rule.

findings.finding: The exhausted Door supply instruction accurately follows English, which permits relocating any board Door token. PL and FR restrict the relocated token to a non-destroyed Door, and DE specifies a closed Door. These sources are not mutually identical, and none is identified in the supplied materials as an erratum that overrides the others.
findings.supported_repair: No mandatory change to the English-following rule is established. For a multilingual source-comparison reference, label the current instruction as the English manual wording and add the PL/FR/DE restriction difference to Source limitations; do not silently replace it with a localization-specific rule.

localization_comparison.assessment: Ordinary Melee draws Contamination before rolling (all manuals p.19). PL/FR p.25 explicitly condition both the no-Contamination and no-Wound exception on a miss. English/German p.25 phrasing is less syntactically explicit, but does not establish a blanket successful-hit exemption. Snapshot inference is supported; missed-draw implementation remains a gap.

All p.12 critical moments state first death. English/Polish p.26 use less restricted death wording; French/German p.26 specify first death. Snapshot correctly preserves the English inconsistency rather than treating a translation as a binding erratum.

PL/FR p.22 put unused/dropped Items under the corresponding deck; DE p.22 removes dropped Items from game. English pp.9,22 and explicit scoped FAQ Items 8 give the Item discard pile. Snapshot correctly follows FAQ; no alternative destination should be imported.

localization_comparison.topic: Red corpse count and Pod selection
localization_comparison.assessment: English/Polish p.3 list five red corpse tokens whereas French/German p.3 list four. English/Polish/French setup p.6 randomly selects the required Pods; German p.6 enumerates lowest-numbered Pods. Snapshot accurately follows English; these differences do not justify changing English setup/components.

English/Polish/German p.20 use the ordinary less-than-or-equal death comparison for the two-card sum. French p.20 refers back to the ordinary method but adds a strict-less-than paraphrase. Snapshot less-than-or-equal statement is strongly supported by the primary English and cross-language agreement; French extra wording is not an overriding erratum.

localization_comparison.topic: Slime timing and retained retreat Injuries
localization_comparison.assessment: PL/FR p.25 specify Slime before Exploration; their p.20 expressly retains Injuries on retreat except into Technical Corridors. Both clarify compatible English rules. Snapshot explicitly covers Technical Corridor Injury removal; F1 identifies the missing entry timing.

source_supported_fidelity.assessment: Broadly supported; no MAJOR contradiction found in the scoped English manual plus FAQ or in the justified Egg Melee interpretation. MINOR reflects a supported timing omission. Localization disagreement is reported separately from English fidelity.
source_supported_fidelity.does_not_mean: A fully resolved standalone replacement for the game and every card.

complete_core.assessment: Not established as completely self-contained or fully resolved. It covers the manual/FAQ standard core extensively, but F1 should be repaired and several cases remain underdetermined in the supplied original sources.
remaining_source_gaps: All eight Adult miniatures in Combat when another must be placed.
Whether Queen development adding an Egg restores an already destroyed Nest.
Implementation of missed Egg Melee no-Contamination exception given ordinary pre-roll draw.
Whether a later death re-unlocks Pods after a prior unlock was reversed.
Exhausted Door supply relocation rule differs among original languages.
complete_core.card_dependency: Original Action, Item, Quest and Weakness card text still governs effects not fully printed in these manuals/FAQ. The sources are insufficient to verify every individual card detail of the six-character core.

limitations: No outside publisher clarification, web lookup, card corpus, later edition, expansion or reader evidence was used.
Printed page references are used; these PDFs align printed pages with page indices.
Translation wording is compared as evidence, not presumed to have priority solely because it is more explicit.
No new manual text is quoted verbatim in this JSON.
